notes: Bare array ordered by created_at DESC. contract change (owner-approved): listing is a pure read — the weekly rollover is projected into each response row but persisted only by write paths (progress, update); each row still gains computed key already_completed_today. Volatile values normalized: 'YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS' timestamps -> <TS>, bare 'YYYY-MM-DD' dates -> <DATE>. Autoincrement ids kept as recorded (first rows of a fresh database).
